countries.population: POP is summed across mutually exclusive L1 UC, UCL and RUR classes for each UNLocID. The 237-area sum differs from the rounded UN WUP2025 F01 World total by 6 persons (published precision).
countries.landArea: landAreaKm2 is the sum of AREA_km2 over L1 UC, UCL and RUR classes. It is area assigned to Degree-of-Urbanisation classes, including open/unbuilt land inside those classes; it is not total legal/geographic national land area. Water and land outside the classified extent may be absent, so do not call the result total world land area or derive a world-land percentage from it.
countries.builtUpArea: builtUpAreaKm2 is the sum of BU_km2 over the same classes. GHSL built-up surface counts roofed structures for any human use, including homes and non-residential buildings; it is not occupied housing area or total inhabited land, and it omits open/rural land without mapped structures.
countries.aggregation: The 237 JRC rows are source country/area units. The world fields sum only those 237 rows, once per UNLocID. The five de facto rows have null stats and are excluded from all sums. The 248 current M49 rows plus Taiwan and Kosovo form the 250-row code-based roster; missing JRC stats stay null rather than being filled from a neighboring parent.
countries.missingness: No 2025 JRC row means stats:null. M49 name/code rows remain present for roster completeness. Five additional de facto territories are scope-only and intentionally have null stats; each overlaps a listed parent jurisdiction.

cities: Queue cityCode is matched directly to WUP city_code; ISO2 is checked.

An explicit registry cityId of wup2025:<city_code> is used first after checking country. Other registry and live rows use normalized full/parenthetical name aliases + matching country + nearest WUP coordinates, maximum 40 km; near-tied duplicate names are unresolved. Country and name alone are never accepted.
Population values are persons derived from source thousands. 2015–2025 average annual log growth is calculated as 100*ln(P2025/P2015)/10; null if baseline is missing.
The supplied normalized JSON lacks WUP city-level 0–3 quality flags; those remain null. The existing 2025 plausibility label is retained separately when present.
Further Wikidata queries were left off after the public SPARQL endpoint began rate-limiting to 1 request/min; only three verified returned GeoNames sitelinks are retained.
Coalesced app-only Washington into canonical Washington, D.C. after same-country name alias and 2.78 km center check; retained app source ID and source coordinates on canonical row.

Wikipedia links are included only when the linked article is about the candidate city/town/municipality; broader administrative-area pages are rejected. A focused manual scope audit on 2026-10-07 corrected Nandail and Golapganj, removed unsupported Lakhai and Bahubal links, and added verified settlement pages in English, Bengali, and Chinese. The original API-derived links and rejected evidence are retained in wikipediaEvidence where reviewed.

The October 8 follow-up adds one distinct Iravipuram village row without transferring population or configured status from the distant WUP Kollam point. Other enrichment-run counters retain their original snapshot meaning.

The October 8 Central Asia capitals integration adds four non-WUP capital rows with no transferred population values. Astana has an accepted app entry scoped to Esil district 254; Bishkek has a verified partial official geometry sample held from runtime pending local geometry QA. Dushanbe and Ashgabat document official registry/portal existence without public parcel geometry.

October 8 African-capital research adds 43 distinct city seats with chosen query locators and no inferred WUP populations. Three accepted city entries are linked to runtime sources; Porto-Novo and Victoria geometry is verified but held for material overlap; Porto-Novo also has self-intersections. This includes separately labelled associated/transitional seats and a disputed/de facto supplement.
methodology.checked: A recorded city investigation, including failed attempts. A configured app source can establish registry identification without supplying a city-specific investigation date.
methodology.registryFound: Yes for city-scoped registry evidence (including local registry offices or cadastral maps), a verified parcel sample, or a source configured for that city. Registry presence does not imply a public geometry API. Broader regional leads with unresolved target coverage remain null; a recorded unsuccessful search is not proof that no registry exists.
methodology.growthRanking: Saved UN WUP 2025 queue: average annual exponential population growth during 2015–2025, at least 50,000 people at both endpoints, and Moderate or High 2025 population plausibility. Rank is among this quality-filtered urban-centre cohort, not municipalities or a forecast.
methodology.nationalCadastreFound: Identified national, parent-country, credentialed or viewer-only cadastre, or a recorded multi-region sample. This is not a claim of territorial completeness.
methodology.impliedParcelsTried: True only for a documented inferred-parcel experiment. A missing historical record remains null.
methodology.integrationAttempts: Recorded qualification outcomes matched by exact country and WUP city identity or exact country and explicit registry city ID, newest first. Historical failures remain visible after later success; current app availability comes from appCityIds. Unscoped provider attempts are not assigned to individual cities.
methodology.cityPopulationAggregation: City populations are not added to estimate world coverage. WUP urban centres can overlap municipal identities; jurisdiction statistics supply the additive denominators.
